blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — VNS Laticrete beat Armed Forced of the Philippines, 30-28, 25-20, 25-21, to book its first win in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Veteran Jau Umandal helped snap the Griffins’ three-game skid, leading the charge with 18 points and 10 excellent receptions as they improved to a 1-3 record. The 16-year-old setter John Howard Guerra dished out 18 excellent sets and scored four, sealing the win with a block. Noy Pedrosa had 11 points for the Griffins.
